payload.core_mechanism_summary: Count sequences using DP with state (length up to n, inflection count up to 2t-1, last height, direction). Inflection count tracks peaks+valleys; answer requires exactly 2t-1 inflections.
payload.rationale: The DP iterates over two main dimensions: position i (1..n) and inflection count j (0..2t-1), making it a 2D DP. Height and direction are small finite domains, so the state is effectively 2D.
